name: Google Drive
label: Google Drive API v3
description: Google Drive API v3 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/google-drive/api_spec.json). Canonical Drive node (also listed under Files & Documents — one node). Official Drive API v3. Restricted scopes for broad Drive. Binary upload host is googleapis.com/upload — metadata create uses /files; download uses alt=media. Official docs: https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/reference/rest/v3. OUTPUT is {status, http_status, data} or {error}. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Inbound webhooks: selecting the :listen operation (listen) via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) + provider signing/verification secret (channel_token) blocks the canvas INPUT port and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start (or binds to any Activity's MESSAGE Boundary Event).
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Google Drive official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"copy"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'copy', 'create_from_text', 'upload', 'download', 'update', 'delete', 'move', 'share', 'search', 'create_folder', 'delete_folder', 'share_folder', 'create_shared_drive', 'get_shared_drive', 'list_shared_drives', 'update_shared_drive', 'delete_shared_drive', 'listen'. listen (:listen role) is configured on the node via webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) for inbound webhooks (blocks the canvas INPUT port). Example: 'copy'.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Inbound webhook events (:listen) emit normalized event data on output. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: copy, create_from_text, upload, download, update, delete, move, share, search, create_folder, delete_folder, share_folder, create_shared_drive, get_shared_drive, list_shared_drives, update_shared_drive, delete_shared_drive, listen. Default: copy. Selecting listen (:listen role) reveals webhook_key ($webhookKeyRef) and provider verification fields (channel_token), blocks the canvas INPUT port, and compiles as a webhook-triggered Message Start or Activity MESSAGE Boundary Event. Example: copy.

configurationParameters.label: Access Token
